# Mooc Mastery

> Free NPTEL / Swayam MCQ practice, mock tests, exam-ready notes and cheatsheets for five 2026 GEC (General Elective) courses. Week 1–12 assignment answers with explanations. No account, no server — progress stays in the browser.

Mooc Mastery is a single-page web app (SPA) that hosts the complete multiple-choice question bank from the weekly NPTEL / Swayam assignments for the July–October 2026 semester. Each question includes four options, the correct answer and a written explanation. Practice modes include random sets, custom week-by-week sets, weak-question drills, bookmarked questions and timed mock tests.

## Key Facts

- **Purpose:** NPTEL and Swayam exam preparation for GEC (General Elective) courses.
- **Semester:** July–October 2026.
- **Weeks covered:** Week 1 through Week 12 for every course.
- **Cost:** Free. No sign-up, no account, no ads, no server.
- **Data storage:** Browser localStorage. Progress is never uploaded.
- **Answer format:** Every question has a correct option plus a short explanatory note.
- **Languages:** English.

## Courses

- [The Joy of Computing using Python](https://mooc-mastery.vercel.app/#joy_of_computing_using_python): IIT Ropar / NPTEL. Week 1–12 MCQs, mock tests, cheatsheet and exam-ready notes covering Python fundamentals, loops, lists, dictionaries, recursion and algorithms.
- [Psychology of Learning](https://mooc-mastery.vercel.app/#psychology_of_learning): IIT Kharagpur / NPTEL. Week 1–12 MCQs, mock tests, cheatsheet and exam-ready notes.
- [Forests and Their Management](https://mooc-mastery.vercel.app/#forests_and_their_management): NPTEL. Week 1–12 MCQs, mock tests, cheatsheet and exam-ready notes.
- [Wildlife Ecology](https://mooc-mastery.vercel.app/#wildlife_ecology): NPTEL. Week 1–12 MCQs, mock tests, cheatsheet and exam-ready notes.
- [Introduction to Internet of Things](https://mooc-mastery.vercel.app/#introduction_to_internet_of_things): NPTEL. Week 1–12 MCQs, mock tests, cheatsheet and exam-ready notes.

## Features

- **Practice mode:** Random sets or custom week selections, from 1 up to the full bank.
- **Mock test mode:** Timed test run with per-question pace analytics.
- **Weak-question drill:** Auto-generated list of every question missed twice or more.
- **Cheatsheet:** A revision page that collects exactly the questions you keep getting wrong.
- **Bookmarks:** Save individual questions for later.
- **Pace analytics:** See where you rush and where you get stuck, question by question.
- **No account, no server:** All progress is stored locally in the browser.
- **Export / Import:** Save a JSON backup of progress and restore it on any device.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Mooc Mastery?
Mooc Mastery is a free web app for practising NPTEL and Swayam multiple-choice questions (MCQs). It hosts the weekly assignment question bank for five courses — The Joy of Computing using Python, Psychology of Learning, Forests and Their Management, Wildlife Ecology, and Introduction to Internet of Things — with the correct answer and a written explanation for every question.

### Is Mooc Mastery free?
Yes. Mooc Mastery is completely free, with no account, no ads, no paywall and no server.

### Do I need to sign up to use Mooc Mastery?
No. Mooc Mastery requires no account and no email. Progress, history, bookmarks and settings are stored locally in your browser using localStorage.

### Which NPTEL courses are covered on Mooc Mastery?
Five NPTEL / Swayam GEC (General Elective) courses are covered: The Joy of Computing using Python (IIT Ropar), Psychology of Learning (IIT Kharagpur), Forests and Their Management, Wildlife Ecology, and Introduction to Internet of Things. Each course includes week 1 through week 12 MCQs.

### Are the NPTEL answers correct?
Every question shows the correct option along with a short written explanation of why it is correct. Questions come from the official NPTEL weekly assignment papers. If you spot a discrepancy, you can report it via the link in the footer.

### What is the mock test mode on Mooc Mastery?
The random-set and custom-set modes act as mock tests. You can draw 10, 20, 30 or all questions from the whole bank or from specific weeks, answer them under a timer, and review your pace, accuracy and per-question time afterwards.

### Does Mooc Mastery work offline?
Mooc Mastery loads the question bank once from a JSON file. After that first load, all practice, review and progress tracking work entirely in your browser. Your progress is never sent to any server.

### Where is my progress stored?
Progress, test history, bookmarks and settings are stored locally in your browser via localStorage. They are never uploaded. Use Settings → Export to save a JSON backup, or Settings → Import to restore it on another device.
